blocks.grass: The surface of most land: Plains, forests, jungles, savannas, swamps, meadows and cherry groves, and mountain slopes that are not too steep. Villages in grass biomes lay it over their plots and roads of [[item:dirt_path]].
blocks.dirt: Lies under grass, usually 2 or 3 blocks deep, and forms the surface of swamp floors under water. Also occurs in underground pockets from about 6 blocks below the surface.
blocks.coarse_dirt: Patches in the surface of Savanna and Old Growth Taiga. Generated in villages: the scratched-up ground of chicken coops and the muddy corner of sties.
blocks.podzol: Patches in the surface of Taiga, Dark Forest and Old Growth Taiga (where it covers most of the ground).
blocks.mycelium: The surface of Mushroom Fields, the small islands far out in the deep ocean.
blocks.mud: The surface and floor of Mangrove Swamps.
blocks.stone: The bulk of the ground, from just under the surface down to y 8, and mixed with deepslate down to y -8. Also bare on steep slopes, high mountains and Stony Shores.
blocks.deepslate: The rock below y -8, mixed with stone between y 8 and y -8. It is the main rock of the deep underground.
blocks.bedrock: The bottom of the world at y -64, with a ragged fade over the four layers above it.
blocks.cobblestone: Natural boulders of cobblestone (a third of the blocks) and [[item:mossy_cobblestone]] lie in Old Growth Taiga. Generated in villages: house foundations, wells, the walls of smithies and churches in most styles.
blocks.mossy_cobblestone: Boulders in Old Growth Taiga, mostly this (seven blocks in ten). Generated in villages: the well of taiga villages.
blocks.sand: Beaches, deserts, and the floor of shallow seas, warm seas and rivers. Generated in villages: the ground and fill of desert villages.
blocks.sandstone: Lies under sand in deserts, beaches and riverbanks. Generated in villages: walls, floors and foundations in desert villages.
blocks.gravel: The floor of deep cold seas and rivers, patches on stony shores, and underground pockets from about 8 blocks below the surface.
blocks.clay: Patches on the floor of shallow seas, rivers and swamps, and underground pockets from 20 to 300 blocks below the surface.
blocks.snow_grass: The surface of Snowy Plains, Snowy Taiga, Snowy Beach above the waterline and Snowy Slopes. Generated in villages: the ground of snowy villages.
blocks.snow: The surface of Ice Spikes, and a cap on Snowy Slopes (above about y 1450) and Jagged Peaks (above about y 1800).
blocks.ice: A sheet on frozen oceans and rivers: solid near the shore and in broken floes further out.
blocks.packed_ice: Spikes in the Ice Spikes biome, and patches on the snowy summits of Jagged Peaks.
blocks.calcite: Streaks in the stone of Stony Peaks.
blocks.water: Oceans, rivers (their surface lies at sea level, y 0, near the coast), swamp hollows and small underground pockets. Generated in villages: wells and the channels in farms and pens.
blocks.terracotta: Plain bands in the layered rock of Badlands, exposed on steep slopes.
blocks.orange_terracotta: The most common band in the layered rock of Badlands. Generated in villages: the roofs of savanna villages.
blocks.magma_block: On the floors of deep caves below y -15, and in buried pockets in the deep rock.
blocks.granite: Large blobs underground, from 5 blocks below the surface downwards.
blocks.diorite: Large blobs underground, from 5 blocks below the surface downwards.
blocks.andesite: Large blobs underground, from 5 blocks below the surface downwards.
blocks.tuff: Blobs deep underground, between y -64 and y 16, replacing both stone and deepslate.
blocks.dripstone_block: Blobs underground, 30 to 250 blocks below the surface.
blocks.coal_ore: Common veins from the surface down to about 200 blocks, strongest about 100 blocks below the ground. Also seen in cliffs and mountainsides. See [[page:caves-and-ores]].
blocks.iron_ore: Common veins from the surface down to about 200 blocks, strongest about 100 blocks below the ground. See [[page:caves-and-ores]].
blocks.copper_ore: Common veins from the surface down to about 200 blocks, strongest about 100 blocks below the ground. See [[page:caves-and-ores]].
blocks.gold_ore: Veins from 32 blocks below the surface to bedrock; richer the deeper you go.
blocks.diamond_ore: Rare veins from 48 blocks below the surface to bedrock; richer the deeper you go.
blocks.lapis_ore: Veins from 24 blocks below the surface to bedrock; richer the deeper you go.
blocks.redstone_ore: Veins from 48 blocks below the surface to bedrock; richer the deeper you go.
blocks.emerald_ore: Single blocks, common in mountain biomes (Windswept Hills, Snowy Slopes, Jagged Peaks and Stony Peaks) from 3 to 500 blocks below the surface. Elsewhere very rare, from 24 blocks down.
blocks.oak_log: Trunks of Plains, Forest, Flower Forest and Swamp, with some in Birch Forest, Dark Forest and Sparse Jungle.. Generated in villages: corner posts and farm borders of plains villages, and the trees of desert-village gardens.
blocks.oak_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Plains, Forest, Flower Forest and Swamp, with some in Birch Forest, Dark Forest and Sparse Jungle.. Also on the trees of desert-village gardens.
blocks.birch_log: Trunks of Birch Forest, Meadow, and about a third of the trees of Forest and Flower Forest..
blocks.birch_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Birch Forest, Meadow, and about a third of the trees of Forest and Flower Forest..
blocks.spruce_log: Trunks of Taiga, Snowy Taiga, Snowy Plains, Old Growth Taiga (including the giant ones) and Windswept Hills.. Generated in villages: corner posts and farm borders of snowy and taiga villages.
blocks.spruce_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Taiga, Snowy Taiga, Snowy Plains, Old Growth Taiga (including the giant ones) and Windswept Hills..
blocks.jungle_log: Trunks of Jungle and Sparse Jungle, including the huge 2x2 trees and the leafy bushes of the jungle floor..
blocks.jungle_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Jungle and Sparse Jungle, including the huge 2x2 trees and the leafy bushes of the jungle floor..
blocks.acacia_log: Trunks of Savanna.. Generated in villages: corner posts of savanna villages.
blocks.acacia_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Savanna..
blocks.dark_oak_log: Trunks of Dark Forest.. Generated in villages: the roofs of taiga villages.
blocks.dark_oak_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Dark Forest..
blocks.cherry_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Cherry Grove..
blocks.mangrove_log: Trunks of Mangrove Swamp, with roots arching down to the mud..
blocks.mangrove_leaves: Crowns of the trees of Mangrove Swamp, with roots arching down to the mud..
blocks.cactus: Grows on sand in deserts, and rarely in Badlands, 1 to 3 blocks tall.
blocks.short_grass: Ground cover in patches on grass and podzol, plentiful in Savanna, Meadow, Plains and Cherry Grove, common in forests, jungles and swamps.
blocks.fern: Ground cover in patches, common in Old Growth Taiga and jungles, scattered in taigas, swamps and forests.
blocks.dead_bush: Scattered on sand, red sand, terracotta and coarse dirt in Deserts and Badlands. Generated in villages: the plaza of desert villages.
blocks.poppy: Flower patches on grass: very common in Flower Forests and Meadows, scattered in Plains and elsewhere. Each patch is one colour. Generated in villages: the plaza flower beds and the flower beds of apiaries.
blocks.dandelion: Flower patches on grass: very common in Flower Forests and Meadows, scattered in Plains and elsewhere. Each patch is one colour. Generated in villages: the flower beds of apiaries.
blocks.cornflower: Flower patches on grass: very common in Flower Forests and Meadows, scattered in Plains and elsewhere. Each patch is one colour. Generated in villages: the flower beds of apiaries.
blocks.red_mushroom: On the ground in Dark Forests, Swamps, Old Growth Taiga and Mushroom Fields, and rarely in forests and taigas.
blocks.brown_mushroom: On the ground in Dark Forests, Swamps, Old Growth Taiga and Mushroom Fields, and rarely in forests and taigas.
blocks.mushroom_stem: The stems of giant mushrooms in Mushroom Fields and, occasionally, Dark Forests.
blocks.red_mushroom_block: The caps of the giant red mushrooms of Mushroom Fields and Dark Forests.
blocks.brown_mushroom_block: The caps of the giant brown mushrooms of Mushroom Fields and Dark Forests.
blocks.sugar_cane: In clumps of 1 to 3 on sand, grass or dirt exactly at sea level beside water, in climates that are not frozen.
blocks.pumpkin: In round patches on grass in most land biomes. Generated in villages: occasional pumpkin patches in farms.
blocks.melon: In patches on grass in Jungle and Sparse Jungle.
blocks.bee_nest: On the trunk of about 3 percent of oak and birch trees in Plains, Forests, Birch Forests and Meadows, just under the leaves.
blocks.dirt_path: Generated in villages: plazas, roads and the doorstep of every building.
blocks.planks: Generated in villages: oak planks form the walls and floors of plains villages, the roofs of snowy villages, and the trim of smithies.
blocks.spruce_planks: Generated in villages: the roofs of plains villages and the walls and floors of snowy and taiga villages.
blocks.acacia_planks: Generated in villages: the walls and floors of savanna villages.
blocks.sandstone_bricks: Generated in villages: corner posts, roofs and wells of desert villages.
blocks.oak_fence: Generated in villages: lamp posts, well corners, the fences of pens, coops, pastures and sties, and the front corner posts of smithies.
blocks.oak_fence_gate: Generated in villages: the gates of pens, pastures, coops and sties.
blocks.lantern: Generated in villages: lamp posts along the roads, inside smithies, libraries and big houses, and under the entry arch.
blocks.bell: Generated in villages: hanging in the well at the centre of every village, and in the tower of each church.
blocks.hay_bale: Generated in villages: on the plaza, in hay stacks, and in pens, coops, pastures and sties.
blocks.farmland: Generated in villages: farm plots, watered by a channel down the middle.
blocks.wheat: Generated in villages: fully grown in farms, the most common crop.
blocks.carrots: Generated in villages: fully grown in farms.
blocks.potatoes: Generated in villages: fully grown in farms, most often in snowy villages.
blocks.beetroots: Generated in villages: fully grown in farms, rare in desert villages.
blocks.crafting_table: Generated in villages: inside houses, libraries, churches, smithies and big houses, and at the market stall on the plaza.
blocks.chest: Generated in villages: in libraries (as shelves), smithies, big houses, upper floors of two-storey houses, and at the market stall on the plaza.
blocks.furnace: Generated in villages: two in each smithy, and beside the glass kiln of a village with a glassmaker.
blocks.ladder: Generated in villages: in two-storey houses, up to the hatch in the upper floor.
blocks.red_bed: Generated in villages: in every home, library, church and smithy; one or two to a building, one for each villager.
blocks.oak_door: Generated in villages: the front door of every house, library, church and smithy.
blocks.glass_pane: Generated in villages: the windows of houses, libraries, churches and smithies (villages made by older generators use [[item:glass]] blocks).
blocks.glass: Not natural. Villages in worlds made with an old village generator use glass blocks for their windows.
blocks.composter: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed beside a farm, for the farmer.
blocks.lectern: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside the library, for the librarian.
blocks.brewing_stand: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside the church, for the cleric.
blocks.blast_furnace: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a smithy, for the armorer.
blocks.grindstone: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a smithy, for the weaponsmith.
blocks.smithing_table: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a smithy, for the toolsmith.
blocks.smoker: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the butcher.
blocks.barrel: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the fisherman.
blocks.loom: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed beside a pen, for the shepherd.
blocks.fletching_table: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the fletcher.
blocks.stonecutter: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the mason.
blocks.cauldron: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the leatherworker.
blocks.cartography_table: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the cartographer.
blocks.drafting_table: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed on the plaza, for the builder.
blocks.survey_table: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed on the plaza, for the explorer.
blocks.band_saw: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the forester.
blocks.carpentry_bench: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed on the plaza or beside a house, for the furniture maker.
blocks.mining_bench: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed inside a house, for the miner.
blocks.merchant_counter: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed on the plaza, for the merchant.
blocks.nesting_box: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed beside the chicken coop, for the poultry keeper.
blocks.milk_churn: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed beside the pasture, for the cowherd.
blocks.bakers_oven: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed on the plaza or beside a house, for the baker.
blocks.glass_kiln: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed on the plaza or beside a house, for the glassmaker.
blocks.honey_extractor: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed beside a farm, for the beekeeper.
blocks.feed_trough: Generated in villages: a workstation, placed beside the sty gate, for the pig farmer.
blocks.beehive: Generated in villages: two beehives beside the honey extractor of a village with a beekeeper.

rules.text: The form of the ore that appears where a vein passes through deepslate (below about y 8). It is found on the same terms as the ordinary ore: for coal, iron and copper only where the ground is low (within about 200 blocks of y -8), for gold, diamond, lapis, redstone and emerald at any ground height, deep down. See [[page:caves-and-ores]].
A band in the layered rock of Badlands, exposed on steep slopes.

Generated in villages: three signs side by side beside the entry arch, reading "Village of ...", with the villager and bed counts, and signposts to nearby villages. The wood depends on the village style: oak (plains), birch (desert), spruce (snowy and taiga), acacia (savanna).
